definitions.gloss: blood sugar level; blood glucose level
definitions.explanation: The concentration of glucose in the blood. A key health indicator, especially for diabetes management and general wellness.

examples.japanese: {血糖値|けっとうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: To measure one's blood sugar level.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食後|しょくご}→食後：09499_shokugo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{血糖値|けっとうち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がり→上がる：00615_agaru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Blood sugar levels tend to rise after eating.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{血糖値|けっとうち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつける→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: The doctor told me my blood sugar was high, so I started watching my diet.

notes:
A compound of {血糖|けっとう} (blood sugar) and {値|ち} (value, level). A very commonly used medical and health term in everyday Japanese, frequently encountered in health checkup results and diet-related discussions.

USAGE:
Appears in medical contexts, health magazines, food labeling discussions, and daily conversation about diet and health. Japan's annual health checkups (⟦{健康診断|けんこうしんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧) routinely measure {血糖値|けっとうち}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {血糖値|けっとうち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ — to have high blood sugar
- {血糖値|けっとうち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧ — blood sugar drops
- {血糖値|けっとうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦コントロール→コントロール：10861_kontorooru⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to control blood sugar
- ⟦{空腹時|くうふくじ}→空腹時：17888_kuufukuji⟧{血糖値|けっとうち} — fasting blood sugar level

- ⟦{血圧|けつあつ}→血圧：00218_ketsuatsu⟧ — blood pressure; another common health measurement
